entries.title: I Am Sam Altman, President of Y Combinator.  AMA
entries.author: sama
entries.current_title: I Am Sam Altman, President of Y Combinator.  AMA
entries.excerpt: YC applications for the Summer 2015 batch are due in a week, so I thought I'd do an AMA to answer questions about applying to YC, how the program works, or anything else. EDIT: 12:55 PM. This has been a really fun three hours, but now I have back to back meetings for the rest of the day. Sorry I couldn't answer everything--I typed as fast as I can :) Special thanks to the YC software team for fixing an issue very quickly in the middle of this!
entries.guide_zh: YC 总裁 Sam Altman 开放问答，围绕申请、项目流程与创业解惑。

entries.title: Ask HN: Does anyone else value the comments more than the link?
entries.author: pvinis
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Does anyone else value the comments more than the link?
entries.excerpt: I always open the comment page of a HN post first, then read a couple of comments. When not many comments are there, I click on the link on top and read the article. Many times, I never read the actual linked article. After reading the comments of people here in HN, I can understand the gist, or more, of the article linked, and also know the thoughts of many people. I enjoy reading the agreeing, disagreeing, proving, disproving, controversial comments much more. Am I the only
entries.guide_zh: 你会先读评论再打开链接吗，作者想知道是否也有人更珍惜讨论本身。

entries.title: Any stories of employees with equity successfully taking home over $1m? $500k?
entries.author: fideloper
entries.current_title: Any stories of employees with equity successfully taking home over $1m? $500k?
entries.excerpt: Equity for employees is commonly part of an employment package, but: 1. It's rare for startups to succeed 2. It's rare for non-owning employees to be able to exercise shares/receive money when the company sells due to the structure of VC-backing/ownership and the resulting order of who gets paid/when We all hear stories about when employee equity does not work out. Are there any examples of when it DOES work out well for an employee with equity?
entries.guide_zh: 员工股权真的能兑现五十万乃至一百万美元吗，作者寻找实际案例。
